description: This file defines the implementation of the DnsConfig class, including constructors, comparison operators, and a method to serialize its data to a dictionary. It manages DNS configuration parameters such as nameservers, DNS over HTTPS settings, and other DNS-related options.

classes.name: DnsConfig
classes.description: Represents DNS configuration settings including nameservers, DNS over HTTPS options, and other DNS parameters.

methods.description: Checks equality with another DnsConfig, including hosts.

methods.description: Serializes the DNS configuration to a dictionary.
